description: Create an unpaid $19 Express 8-file or $49 Self-Serve 26-file ZIP order. Returns order_ref, Base Mainnet USDC details, x402 URL and no-account AnonPay XMR URL. No payment is sent; XMR is verified within 24h. Reuse idempotency_key to recover a retry.

domain.description: Public domain, for example example.com; private hosts are rejected.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for retries of this order; omit to create a new order.

payment_method.description: USDC on Base Mainnet or Monero via AnonPay.

tier_slug.description: Express costs 19.00 USDC; Self-Serve costs 49.00 USDC.

name: create_aso_pack_order
title: Create a pack order
